gate_rules: Self-authored issues do not count as external evidence.
Reviewer must grant explicit permission before a run or feedback is counted.
A docs-only review does not count as a confirmed run.
Commands or URLs used, observed result, and main feedback must be non-placeholder text.
AI Engineer review issues require explicit permission plus inspected paths and concrete signal feedback.
Issues containing sensitive-data risk terms are rejected until redacted.
not_claimed: No accepted external reviewer issue exists yet.
No user, feedback, reproducible-run, business-case, or AI Engineer review count is increased by planning issues.
No private business data is accepted as evidence.
purpose: Validate public reviewer issues before they can increase resume-safe user, feedback, reproducible-run, business-case, or AI Engineer review metrics.
resume_safe_summary: Published a CI-verified external reviewer evidence gate that validates issue body fields, explicit permission, non-owner authorship, runnable-path evidence, and sensitive-data guardrails before any reviewer issue can increase resume-safe usage, feedback, or AI Engineer review metrics.
